MEGA is a U.S.-domiciled ETF and NVDA is a U.S. issuer; the June dividend is a U.S.-source dividend paid to a U.S. holder, to which no withholding tax applies. No withholding schedule is needed. The NET cash is fully determined: 180,000 shares (post-split position on the dividend record date 2024-06-11) x $0.01 post-split rate = $1,800.00 net, equal to gross, payable 2024-06-28. The receivable should have been answered/booked at $1,800.00 rather than escalated as not-determinable.
D2 worksheet probe value should be 1800.00 (net = gross, no withholding), not null/NOT_DETERMINABLE.
